name: Aramis Group SAS
summary: Aramis Group SAS specializes in the digital retail of pre-owned vehicles across Europe. The company manages a portfolio of brands, including Aramisauto, Cardoen, and Clicars, which serve markets in France, Belgium, and Spain. Furthermore, it oversees the CarSupermarket platform in the United Kingdom. Established in 2001, Aramis Group maintains its corporate headquarters in Arcueil, France.
